question: When does the propitiated initiate reach Shiva?
premises: having propitiated him, from the pleased one gaining Shankari initiation
at body-fall, to Shiva may go
inference: Pleased-guru initiation delivers now, through enjoyment, or at death.
plain_english: Having propitiated him, from the pleased one gaining Shankari initiation — that moment, by enjoyment, or at body-fall, to Shiva may go.
